items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: That's where I first heard Dorothy Donegan. She sat in with us sometimes.

ctx.x: Things were going on back then in Chicago?

Yeah. It would go on late, everything around until about five or six o'clock. Then you had the breakfast dances. It was a ...(?)... That's where I first heard Dorothy Donegan. She sat in with us sometimes. But as a rule... Man, she could play, but she would always lose about
